verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and model fine-tuning platform. Its 'automation' is tool-calling done by a model inside the developer's own app, not a workflow product where users author automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its category. The only versioning evidence is pinning an older model generation (Needle 2). That is model-version selection, not automation versioning, so it does not make this axis apply.
